message.content:
**Order filled:** 44 shares of AAPL at $222.80 = $9,803.20.

**Summary:** I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, filed November 1, 2024) and checked the live quote ($222.70 last, $222.68/$222.72 bid/ask). The filing shows Apple's **operating income for fiscal 2024 was $123,216 million**, up 7.8% from $114,301 million in fiscal 2023 — driven by total net sales of $391,035 million (up 2%), gross margin of $180,683 million (46.2% of sales, up from 44.1%), and Services revenue growth of 13% to $96,169 million. Net income fell to $93,736 million from $96,995 million, but that decline was entirely attributable to a one-time, non-operating $10.2 billion net income tax charge related to the European Commission's State Aid Decision (effective tax rate 24.1% vs. 14.7%); underlying operating profitability improved, and the company generated $118,254 million of operating cash flow. On that basis I judged AAPL a reasonable buy and placed a single limit order for 44 shares at $222.80 — a limit just above the ask and within pennies of the market price, for a notional of $9,803.20, which is under the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily cap, funded entirely from the account's $50,000 cash with no money moved out. The order filled at $222.80. The key figure cited in the order's key_figures is Apple's fiscal 2024 operating income of $123,216 million (USD millions).
